description: Read the user's application profile: the answers GetMattered types into employer application forms. It returns contact details and links; work details (current employer, date of birth, work authorization, relocation, start date, notice period, travel, security clearance, education, years of experience and a short personal note); the five legal declarations; and the voluntary self-identification (EEO) answers. It also returns the open questions: required fields that are empty, and details recent applications had to guess because the user never gave them, each with the field that answers it. The EEO answers and the date of birth are sensitive: show them only to the user. Read-only: it changes nothing and spends no credits. Do not use it to save answers; use getmattered_update_application_profile. Next: ask the user for anything still open, then getmattered_update_application_profile.
name: getmattered_get_application_profile

changed.description: The input fields this call saved. Empty from getmattered_get_application_profile, which only reads.

missingRequiredForApply.description: Fields employer forms require that are still empty. Ask the user; never guess.

fact.description: The detail recent applications filled with a guess.

setWith.description: The input fields that answer it. Empty when it is asked per application and cannot be preset.

openQuestions.description: Details GetMattered guessed because the user never gave them. Null when they could not be read.

profile.description: The saved answers employer forms are filled from, after this call. Field names are the API's camelCase twins of the inputs.

title: Get Application Profile
